notes.title: Patch Notes Ver1.0.6
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying “NINJA SLAYER NEO-SAITAMA IN FLAMES”.
The latest patch (Ver1.0.6) is now available.
The details of the fixes and changes are as follows.

●Details
・The camera position in stage and boss ninja battles can now be changed (you can choose between two options: near or far).
  The “far” stage camera and “near” boss ninja camera are the previous cameras
・Combo numbers now correspond to Arabic numerals (when a language other than Japanese is selected)
・After clearing the game, it is now possible to skip all cutscenes.
・In cutscenes, it is now possible to advance by pressing the button after each dialogue display.

notes.title: Patch Notes Ver1.0.5
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying “NINJA SLAYER NEO-SAITAMA IN FLAMES”.
The latest patch (Ver. 1.0.5) has been released.
The patch includes the following changes.
●Game content update
- Tutorial content has been changed (to explain the controls more clearly)
- Suriken damage has been adjusted (except for boss ninjas (except for some bosses))

notes.title: Patch Notes Ver1.0.4
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying “NINJA SLAYER NEO-SAITAMA IN FLAMES”.
The latest patch (Ver1.0.4) has been applied.
The details of the fixes and changes are as follows.
●Bug fixes
- Fix for a bug that occurs when clearing a stage
- Fix for a bug that occurs during the Hellcite battle
●Game content updates, etc.
- The voice for the Ninja Slayer's attack has been unified to “Yeeart!”
- The size of the rocks thrown by the Interrupter has been changed (making it easier to counter with a shuriken)
- The sensitivity when entering commands for the Alabama Otoshi has been improved
- The game now supports control with the directional pad
- Signboards have been placed at checkpoints in stages

notes.title: Patch notes Ver1.0.3
notes.content:
The latest patch has been applied to the Steam version. Fixes and changes are as follows.

Adjustment of game balance
・Changed the strength of some enemy characters (Clone Yakuza Y-12 (yellow), Y-13 (white), etc.)
・The Ninja Slayer is now less slippery when moving.
・Reduced the amount of movement when Ninja Slayer is hit by an attack that blows him up.
・The gauge consumption of the dash attack has been reduced.
・The Ninja Slayer's normal attacks now have a larger judgment.
・The amount of movement speed increase in Naraku mode has been reduced.
・The amount of energy regenerated after exiting Naraku mode has been increased.
・Jitsu counts are now restored to maximum when restarting boss battles.
・The conditions for the secret mission in the Sonic Boom stage have been relaxed.

Bug Fixes
・Fixed a bug that made it difficult for Cloudbuster and Hellkite to hit.
・Fixed a bug that caused the restart point of the Iron Vice boss battle to be off and the player would fall.
・Fixed a bug that caused FPS to drop during Cloudbuster boss battles.
・Fixed a bug that prevented Notorious from reappearing in Notorious Battles.
・Fixed a bug that caused the Daedalus boss battle to become unprogressable.
・Fixed a bug that prevented the moving floor from working in some stages.
・Text corrections were made, including correcting Korean to the correct translation file.
・Some minor bugs have been fixed.
